title: 'I can be played to a battlefield where there are enemy units' not implemented
expected: `CanPlayToEnemyBattlefield` appears only in the card file (riftbound-cards/src/cards/unl/rengar-trophy-hunter.ts:27); zero references in riftbound-engine or apps. In play-unit.ts condition (lines 116-177), an enemy-controlled battlefield target matches none of: conquered-only (118), controlled-bf (123: requires targetBf.controller === playerId), open-bf (128: requires !targetBf.controller). With Ambush it falls to the Ambush branch (143-162) which requires friendly units at that battlefield via canPlayViaAmbush(hasAmbush, hasFriendlyUnits, true) at line 160 — returns false when p1 has no units there. So Rengar cannot be played to an enemy battlefield with only enemy units, at either main-phase or Reaction timing; the enumerator (line ~301-351) likewise only offers Ambush battlefields with friendly units and controlled battlefields.
observed: On p1 turn 3 main phase enumerator offered only location 'base' and the p1-controlled battlefield; direct playUnit to battlefield-player-2-bf-ogn-275-298 returned CONDITION_FAILED (also rejected during the showdown). 'CanPlayToEnemyBattlefield' grant-keyword has no handling anywhere in riftbound-engine (grep finds it only in the card file)

history.note: play-unit honours CanPlayToEnemyBattlefield grant (unl-120-219) in condition + enumerator
